name: Coaster Set
instruction: Could you design a coaster set for me?

Shape accuracy: The coasters are circular in shape.
Each coaster is uniform in size.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: Each coaster has a diameter of 10cm.
The thickness of each coaster is 0.5cm.
Proportion: Each coaster is proportionally consistent, with a circular shape and uniform thickness throughout.
The diameter-to-thickness ratio of each coaster is balanced, ensuring functionality and aesthetic appeal.
Texture and surface detail: The surface has a textured finish for grip.
The edges are smooth to prevent scratching surfaces.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The coasters are stacked neatly when not in use.
Each coaster is flat and stable on a surface.
Object distance and contact: The coasters do not overlap when stacked.
There is adequate space between coasters when placed side by side.

Instruction execution accuracy: The design accurately reflects a coaster set.
All specified attributes are considered in the design.
